review_text: Subject: Inquiry Regarding International Payment Services and Online Gaming Top-ups. Dear eSewa Team, I am writing to suggest that eSewa explore partnerships with international banks or payment providers to enable services like direct international dollar payments and online game top-ups. Many users, including myself, would find this feature very beneficial and it would significantly enhance eSewa's value. We hope you will consider this for the future
